# Fintech Summarizer

> Free web app that turns any stock or crypto ticker (AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, BTC, ETH…) into an AI market briefing: the 5 latest news articles plus a streaming, structured summary (headline, market overview, three key insights, sentiment) written by Anthropic's Claude, and a chat for follow-up questions grounded in those articles. English and Spanish. Educational project — not financial advice.

## Pages

- [Home / app](https://fintech-summarizer.vercel.app/): search a ticker, read news cards, AI summary and chat.
- [Privacy & disclaimer](https://fintech-summarizer.vercel.app/privacy): data handling, cookies, AI and news-source disclaimers.

## How it works

- News: Finnhub.io — company news tagged with the exact stock symbol (last 7 days); for crypto, Finnhub's crypto market news filtered by coin symbol and name.
- AI: Claude (Haiku family) via the Vercel AI SDK; structured output validated with Zod and streamed over Server-Sent Events.
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, deployed on Vercel.
